label: resonance region fitted by INCOGNITA to raw EXFOR transmission data (own Reich-Moore fit); not a library file

segments.what: Reich-Moore fit (joint Zr-isotope fit to EXFOR transmission 13736002, 13741002, 12940004-12940008): R' 6.19 fm and one bound s-level at -3.12 keV; no resonance lies below 1 keV

thermal.note: no registered measured thermal capture judge for Zr-90; fit value 0.0297 +- 0.0328 b (MC sd)

ri.note: integral of capture/E from 0.5 eV over the whole 0 K PENDF: this file below 1 keV, ENDF/B-VIII.1 carrier above.

join.note: energy-averaged 800-1200 eV, since a pointwise value at 1 keV falls between resonances

sources: EXFOR transmission 13736002, 13741002, 12940004-12940008 (fitted jointly with Zr-91/92/94/96); held-out RPI 13744002-008
thermal free-atom elastic judge: Koester (EXFOR entry in rl/zrfit)
reconstruction: NJOY2016 RECONR 0 K (RESINTEG arm Zr90_ZF, desktop ~/resinteg/arms/Zr90_ZF; tape sha256 in its status.json)
above 1 keV the carrier file is ENDF/B-VIII.1 (not drawn here; it enters only the 1000-1200 eV half of the join average and the RI tail)
caveat: PROVISIONAL own fit: a single isotopic training set, so set admission could not be tested. The held-out RPI transmission (natural Zr, EXFOR 13744002-008) cannot tell this file from ENDF/B-VIII.1 (chi2 ratio 1.0000): neither has a level below 1 keV. Thermal free-atom elastic 5.25 +- 0.18 b vs 5.19 +- 0.16 b measured (Koester). Thermal capture is poorly determined (0.030 +- 0.033 b) and has no measured judge. Hafnium impurity peaks (2.4, 2.9, 7.8 eV) were masked. in the hybrid library lib_res_v0 (RESINTEG, 2026-10-27) as PROVISIONAL. The Explorer's smooth 1 keV capture value (0.243 b, engine average) is 2886 times this file's 800-1200 eV average (8.4e-05 b, ENDF/B-VIII.1 carrier above 1 keV), so the step at 1 keV comes from the engine curve, not from this file.
caveat_short: provisional own fit; held-out check cannot distinguish it from ENDF/B-VIII.1
